name: Sinus Drops
composition: acute and chronic catarrh of the nose
lack of olfaction and taste and the formation of polyps.
dosage:
Acute conditions- 10 drops in some water every 1-2 hours.

Chronic conditions- 10-15 drops 3-4 times a day.

Safety Information:

Do not exceed the recommended dosage
Read the label carefully before use
Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight
Keep out of reach of children
